# md5 eb06eaa718877dfcabee6e8f89d85b31) run under emulation: the subtitle setter and clear, PLAYVOICE, the

# given by the md5 of their Windows-1252 bytes (- empty). Ops: flip | sub d l r g b (the star room's tip:
# GetTextFromDial, flag 0) | caption d l r g b (the same with flag 1: a cinematic caption) | clear |
# voice d l r g b | end NAME | stop NAME | clearvoices | subon 0|1. FONT: the fonts made at the size
# (CreateFontA). LAYOUT mL mR mT mB halign valign; DRAW x y colour font n dx md5(line); after each flip
# SLOT k busy rgb voice md5(text) and SUB flag rgb md5(text). The world's dialogs: Bagdad (3).
